meta.source: Computed walk-forward retrospective baseline evaluation; not archived published forecasts; computed at generatedAt

metricDefinitions.Win accuracy: Top-ranked driver equals the recorded winner; ties break by canonical driver ID.
metricDefinitions.Top-3: Recorded winner is among the three highest forecast probabilities; not podium coverage.
metricDefinitions.Cohort: Retrospective chronological backtest, minimum 3 prior races. Uses the previous race field; excludes roster changes. 5 races excluded. Model and uniform baseline use the same eligible races. No current-race outcome enters its forecast.
metricDefinitions.Probability: Dirichlet categorical posterior: (prior season wins + 1) / (wins among assumed field + field size). No grid, weather, practice, track or team inputs. Uncalibrated baseline, not promoted ML.
metricDefinitions.Baseline: Uniform field probability; top-1 tie breaks by canonical driver ID. Not a pole-position baseline.
